title: Reject stale tool evidence before external decisions
narrative: Tool results that drive external decisions must carry source and freshness metadata. Eight-day-old CRM cache must not be silently treated as current. Context freshness scoring already exists in `fangore_jev_context_picker` and `fangore_insp_context_provider`; typed tool-result TTL remains a delta. Tracks personal-agent inspiration MH-PA-01[^insp-pa-01].
implementation: Adjacent: harness `ToolResult` in `mechaharness.core.types` (tool_call_id/content/is_error only); context-candidate freshness in `context_provider` / decision-plane packing. Desired: typed provenance and expiry on tool results with graph reject-before-decision.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-PA-01, coverage partial, adjacent_ok true.
